reviews.title: Its ok
reviews.text:
Made an account a couple months ago, then deleted it after the 1 week subscription ended. Overall, its not great or terrible. It alright. My only positive feedback is at least the profiles are real people, and not scammers. The verification process is legit so thats nice. But other than that, the subscription prices are still way too high ($24 for a week, $50 or more for a month or year). And just like Tinder, Bumble, Hily, etc. you have to pay to see who likes you and message them. I’m sorry but that’s ridiculous. Once you subscribe, that should be free automatically! The app also rarely shows you people in your area. It always defaults to other states or countries. And you have to CONSTANTLY change the filters to see more people. If someone does view or like you, they never message you back. Which should be mandatory! I get people are busy, but not responding at all, or leaving you on “Read” is plain rude. 
Bottom line, HUD could use some serious improvements.
